no_exception_reason._comment: Optional. Present ONLY when a stakeholder explicitly confirmed that no exception case applies to this story -- never set by user-stories-agent on its own to satisfy the Definition of Ready gate (that would be fabricating behavior, same discipline as acceptance_criteria itself). `reason` and `stated_by` are required together the moment this object exists: a waiver with either one missing or empty is malformed, and check-definition-of-ready.sh fails closed on it (distinct message from 'no waiver at all') -- it never infers 'no exception was knowable' from silent absence of this object. Scoped per-story: a waiver on one HU never satisfies another HU's gate. If `reason` text may contain a literal `"` character, note it does NOT survive check-definition-of-ready.sh's/assemble-spec-package.sh's shared `field()` sed extractor (pre-existing limitation, see Plan-de-Mejora-Pipeline.md punto 10 -- same as any other free-text field in this pipeline).
no_exception_reason.reason: string (why no exception case applies to this story) | omit the whole object if not applicable
no_exception_reason.stated_by: string (stakeholder role) -- required, never null; an unconfirmed guess is not a waiver
